releaseNotes: Smart Lookup & Merge: match records between sheets or workbooks and bring selected fields into your table without writing lookup formulas.
Supports single or multiple matching keys, smart key suggestions, duplicate detection and missing-record analysis - with a full preview of every planned change before anything is written.
Safe merge controls: fill blanks only, replace changed values, or review conflicts one by one. Leading-zero and long identifiers are protected, and formulas or merged cells are never overwritten.
Every apply creates a verified backup, verifies each written cell and offers one-step Undo for the whole merge.
